theme.title: The 1970 Finals
theme.subtitle: Knicks vs Lakers
theme.recap: The 1970 Finals had a 60-foot buzzer-beater and Willis Reed's walk-out in Game 7, where Walt Frazier did the damage.

questions.prompt: The 1969–70 Knicks set what was then a single-season record winning streak. How long was it?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Knicks had a then single-season NBA record 18 straight victories en route to 60–22 record

questions.prompt: Walt Frazier scored 36 points in Game 7 of the 1970 Finals. How many assists did he have?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: took it from there, finishing with 36 points and 19 assists as the Knicks won the championship, 113–99.

questions.prompt: Willis Reed limped out for Game 7 of the 1970 Finals. How many minutes did he play?
questions.note: 27. He did not leave after his first two baskets, despite the legend.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Contrary to popular lore, he did not sit out after his first two baskets, but remained on the floor for 27 minutes

questions.prompt: Jerry West forced overtime in Game 3 of the 1970 Finals with a buzzer-beater from how many feet?
questions.context: 1970 NBA Finals · Game 3 · at New York

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: hit a desperation buzzer-beating 60-foot shot to tie it at 102 and force OT

questions.prompt: Elgin Baylor led the Lakers to the Finals how many times, losing every one?

source.quote: helped lead the team to the NBA Finals eight times, but the team lost each time.
